name: Foothills Crypt
arrivalText: A chilling draft escapes from the cracked stone doors of the ancient crypt nestled in the southern valley cliffs.
description: An abandoned burial site of the ancient Eldorian settlers, now overrun by cave bats, mine spiders, and low-level cave creatures.
visualTheme: Damp mossy stone corridors, cobwebs, dusty burial alcoves, and cold dark corners.

history.createdWhy: Built as a final resting place for the founding nobles of the Eldoria foothills.
history.builtWho: Masons of the early Eldoria Dynasty.
history.majorEvents: Desecrated and looted by grave robbers decades ago, sparking curses and infestation.
history.whyExists: Stands as a grim reminder of the region's forgotten ancestors.
history.currentConflicts: Cave creatures and spiders are spilling out into the South Gate pastures.
